feature: PATCH_004: Python package check (four-product audit). On a fresh Python, 01 Planning and 02 Evaluation stopped at start-up (ModuleNotFoundError: reportlab) while the Installer and the installation guide said nothing more had to be installed once Python was detected. New package_check.py (no tkinter) reads requirements.txt of every product folder beside the Installer (the launcher's own folder search), asks the DETECTED Python which packages it can import (an import probe, nothing is installed) and builds the pip command. The list shows each package, the products using it, required (source edition start-up) or optional (dev_checks only) and Detected/Not Detected; the footer names the missing packages; the new 'Install Command' button shows the command and copies it to the clipboard for the user to run. A frozen EXE searches beside the EXE. Installation guides (JA/EN) no longer say that no additional installation is needed and describe the new step. dev_checks/patch_004_python_package_check_self_check.py added. Installer version stays 5.0.4 (installer_independent).
